source.description:

pack.topic: Coimbatore Home Handover: Bathroom Plumbing & Tile Slope Inspection
pack.source_script_insight: Using a systematic walkthrough to identify hidden bathroom defects like poor floor slope, hollow tiles, and under-sink plumbing leaks before handover.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Helping home buyers in Coimbatore (Saravanampatti, Vadavalli, Thudiyalur) inspect newly built villas and apartments for construction defects before final settlement.
pack.core_takeaway: Never accept a property handover without a thorough wet-area inspection; check floor slopes, tile hollows, and plumbing connections to avoid costly repairs.

scenes.purpose: Hook: Show a modern Coimbatore bathroom sink with running water to test drainage.
scenes.visual: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chrome deck-mounted faucet running water into a clean white ceramic washbasin in a newly built Coimbatore apartment. Natural daylight streams through a small ventilator window.
scenes.camera: Subtle handheld tilt-down following the water flow.

scenes.visual: Camera pans down below the granite counter ledge to show a white corrugated waste pipe connected to the wall outlet. A hand gently checks the joint for moisture.
scenes.camera: Smooth downward pan, close-up focus on the pipe joint.

scenes.purpose: Show water pooling on bathroom floor tiles due to poor slope.
scenes.visual: Low-angle shot of water stagnating on matte grey anti-skid floor tiles instead of flowing toward the stainless steel floor drain trap.
scenes.camera: Static low-angle shot focusing on the standing water.

scenes.visual: A hand uses white chalk to mark a circle and write 'SLOPE' on a defective floor tile right next to the drain trap.
scenes.camera: Close-up shot, high angle looking straight down at the tile.

scenes.purpose: Check for hollow tiles using a tapping tool.
scenes.visual: An inspector's hand taps a floor tile with a small metallic testing rod, showing a realistic inspection technique.
scenes.camera: Close-up tracking shot following the tapping tool.

scenes.visual: An engineer holds a clipboard with a 'Bathroom Snag List' document inside the bathroom, ticking off items like 'Floor Slope' and 'Plumbing Joints'.

scenes.purpose: Call to action with brand overlay.
scenes.visual: A wide, clean shot of the fully inspected, modern bathroom. A transparent overlay with the OliveTree SafeBuy logo and contact info appears.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Create an EXACTLY 10-second, 7-scene vertical 9:16 video focusing on bathroom construction quality inspection for home buyers in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The video must look 90%+ like photorealistic live-action smartphone or gimbal footage, with natural daylight, realistic textures, and no cartoon or 3D explainer animation. Brand: OliveTree SafeBuy. Location context: Coimbatore. 

Scene 1 (0.0-1.4s): Close-up of a modern chrome faucet running water into a white ceramic washbasin in a newly built Coimbatore apartment. Natural light from a side window. Text overlay: 'புது வீடா?'. Voice-over: 'கோயம்புத்தூர்ல புது வீடு வாங்குறீங்களா?'

Scene 2 (1.4-2.8s): Camera pans down below the granite counter to show a white flexible waste pipe and stainless steel inlet hoses. A hand checks the joint for leaks. Text overlay: 'பைப் லீக்?'. Voice-over: 'பாத்ரூம் பைப் லீக்,'

Scene 3 (2.8-4.2s): Low-angle shot of water pooling on matte grey floor tiles, failing to drain toward a circular steel drain trap. Text overlay: 'தண்ணீர் தேங்குதா?'. Voice-over: 'தண்ணீர் தேங்கும் தரை,'

Scene 4 (4.2-5.5s): Close-up of a hand marking 'SLOPE' in white chalk on a floor tile next to the drain. Text overlay: 'தவறான ஸ்லோப்!'. Voice-over: 'ஹோலோ டைல்ஸ்னு'

Scene 5 (5.5-7.0s): Close-up of a hand tapping a floor tile with a metallic key or rod to check for hollow sounds. Text overlay: 'செக் பண்ணுங்க!'. Voice-over: 'எல்லாத்தையும் ஹேண்டோவருக்கு முன்னாடி செக் பண்ணுங்க.'

Scene 6 (7.0-8.5s): Over-the-shoulder shot of an engineer holding a clipboard with a 'Bathroom Snag List' in the bathroom. Text overlay: 'ஸ்னாக் லிஸ்ட்'. Voice-over: 'ஒலிவ்ட்ரீ சேஃப்பாய் மூலம்'

Scene 7 (8.5-10.0s): Wide, clean shot of the modern bathroom. A transparent overlay with the OliveTree SafeBuy logo and text 'SafeBuy செக்!' appears. Voice-over: 'உங்கள் முதலீட்டை பாதுகாத்திடுங்கள்!'

CONTINUITY & REALISM RULES:
- Maintain consistent lighting (bright morning daylight) and bathroom materials (grey floor tiles, white ceramic, chrome fixtures) across all scenes.
- No visible cameraman, no cartoon elements, no floating 3D houses.
- All text overlays must be clean, modern, and placed in the lower or upper third of the screen.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Do not include any cartoon, 2D explainer, anime, 3D render, glossy corporate graphics, floating documents, fake futuristic elements, or landscape orientation. No black bars or blurred sidebars.
pack.title_english: Don't Accept Your Coimbatore Home Without This Bathroom Check!
pack.caption_english: Buying a new villa or apartment in Coimbatore? Don't let minor bathroom defects turn into major renovation headaches later! Before signing the final handover document, perform a thorough wet-area audit. Check for proper floor slopes to prevent water stagnation, inspect under-sink plumbing for hidden leaks, and tap floor tiles to identify hollow spots. OliveTree SafeBuy helps Coimbatore home buyers verify construction quality and secure their hard-earned investments. Get a professional snagging checklist before you move in!
